integrity: Analytical general-dimensional proof included; finite exact-rational computational verification of all vertex pairs in dimensions 2 to 12; no claim of independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The hollow-only nearest-edge subformula was known previously and is not asserted as new. New assertions cover full-symmetric mixed pairwise metric extrema and sharp order-five crossover. The normalizations are the total-entry-sum-one full-matrix Frobenius metric. No nonsymmetric family, general nearest-point projection or entire edge-length histogram is asserted. Historical priority requires independent confirmation.
title: A sharp nearest-edge transition and mixed diameters in symmetric Monge simplices
